privacyText: Naya Aasha collects only the information needed to respond to enquiries, coordinate programs, and meet legal obligations. Personal data is not sold. Sensitive information is handled only by authorized people and retained only as long as necessary.
safeguardingText: The safety, dignity, and rights of children and adults at risk come first. We do not publish identifying stories, photographs, medical details, or personal histories without appropriate informed consent. Concerns should be reported through the designated safeguarding contact.
